feeModel.scope: UK domestic Grocery and Gourmet; UK-established Professional seller

basis: Screen all 43 ASINs. Use case price / complete Amazon sales per case; leftovers carry zero recovery in the cash-cost scenario. Select the lowest of stored candidate, screenshot and storefront selling-price observations as a downside scenario, never as a current Buy Box quote. Show 0% and 20% additional supplier-tax scenarios; these do not establish the supplier's tax treatment or the seller's VAT registration.
notes: Code defaults may differ from browser-saved personal settings.
The £25 total-profit check below assumes one supplier case. It is not a permanent £25-per-case rule; a multi-case opportunity must be evaluated separately.
All netProfit and roi fields remain null until fees, tax, prep, transport, current prices and selling eligibility have sufficient evidence.
Amazon fee SP-API configuration checked: NOT_CONFIGURED. Saved market checks: 0.
